example:
import { DashboardGrid } from "@godxjp/ui/lab";

<DashboardGrid items={[{ id: "revenue", label: "Revenue", content: "Revenue" }]} defaultLayout={[{ id: "revenue", x: 0, y: 0, w: 2, h: 3 }]} columns={{ base: 1, lg: 4 }} editable />
name: DashboardGrid

props.description: Stable ids, visible header labels (also accessible region names) and widget body content. Wrap padded bodies in CardContent, tables in CardContent flush; DashboardGrid owns the Card and header. DOM reading order remains items order.
props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: string; content: ReactNode }[]

props.description: Controlled layout: {id,x,y,w,h}, integer cells, zero-based x from inline-start.
props.name: layout

props.description: One callback per changed drop; Escape restores without saving.
props.name: onLayoutChange

props.description: Default 12. Responsive viewport breakpoints; a single column stacks at natural content heights. Narrow projection never overwrites saved layout.
props.name: columns
props.type: number | { base: number; sm?: number; md?: number; lg?: number; xl?: number }

props.description: Positive pixel row track size. Omitted uses --dashboard-grid-row-height.
props.name: rowHeight

props.description: Default false. Inset header grip and bottom-end resize corner (on hover/focus); header space is reserved in view mode to prevent content shift. Enter/Space grab/drop, arrows move, Shift+arrows resize, Escape cancels.
props.name: editable

tagline: BI widget layout editor with deterministic push-down collisions and vertical compaction. Static CSS grid in view mode; temporary pointer/touch/keyboard previews commit once on drop.
usage: C7 exception approved by the owner, BI precedents (Tableau/Power BI/Grafana/react-grid-layout). Approved 2026-10-23. Lab §2.1: same gates as core; promotion only once ≥2 repos import it.
Use stable unique ids and order items by reading priority. Persist only onLayoutChange.
Coordinates are normalized and compacted. View mode exposes content semantics, not an ARIA data grid.
RTL mirrors x and horizontal keyboard/pointer deltas. Touch-action none is confined to handles.
Theme --dashboard-grid-gap, row-height, handle-size, handle-inset, item-radius and preview-ring-color.
useCases: BI dashboards with rearrangeable and resizable widgets.
